eis_specs.document_title: Magnetite Energy Hub — EPBC source (v3.31.0 hybrid source-hunt)
eis_specs.connection_augmentation: Three 275 kV transmission lines on two sets of lattice towers from onsite substation to Powerlink Larcom Creek Substation.
eis_specs.notes: Regime: EPBC. Private Energy Partners (Quinbrook affiliate). Sited near Mount Larcom (Gladstone SDA), QLD, ~194.58 ha (131.8 ha disturbance). Connects to Powerlink's Larcom Creek Substation via 3 x 275 kV lines. Component mix within the hub aligns with Supernode-family portfolio (~1 GW class). Assessed under EPBC. AEMO KCI Q00217. Part of Gladstone SDA Energy Hub (Private Energy Partners): multi-tech energy hub with 780 MW / 6,240 MWh (8-hr) BESS + up to 1,188 MW gas turbines. Site ~194.58 ha total with 131.8 ha disturbance.
